plugins.name: cm-workspace
plugins.description: Change-management working tools. Seven skills: an RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and evaluation criteria; a communications generator that drafts change comms for a requested channel and routes each to the tool that builds it; a status-update agent that diffs this period's programme documents against last period's and drafts the cadence-meeting update; a change-impact-assessment generator that populates a client's own CIA template from programme source material, including interview transcripts and process design; a training-material generator that produces a first-draft training deck from a functional spec, with annotated screenshots and native diagrams; a deck-builder that turns a client brand, approved template and source documents into a first-draft consulting deck across nine deck types, sharing its template-profiling, layout-mapping and pptx-assembly core with a published artifact; and an effort estimator that sizes a change pursuit in mandays from scope drivers. Every generative skill writes from a shared curated knowledge bank where applicable and audits its output for coverage and content provenance before anything is produced.
